Name: Platonic's Recipes
Author: Macskasajt
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS]This will be the mod for the recipes for my other mods, but it is still in development.

It contains most of the recipes from Kynseed, a few for Pumpkin Days, and 13 for Exotic Stuff!



[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]A little help[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]- To obtain the recipes for the Pumpkin Days mod, you have to wait until the 4th year, and for some of the Kynseed ones, until the 2nd year.[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]- The 1.1 update includes a Syrup and an Ice Cream, you can make those in the Syrup Maker, and in The Ice Cream Machine respectively. You have to have all of the hybrid plants in your inventory, plus a milk for the Ice Cream and a sugar for the Syrup. Simply right click the machine with the "Banapple" in your hand.[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]If you experience any incompatibility or any other bug, please report it! Also feel free to use the Posts section![/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Please note, that some of the recipes do need a few PPJA mods to work, because[/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS] I did not want to recreate the crops, see the requirements tab![/font][/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]A big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/27323031]martin66789[/url], who helped a lot with the Hungarian translations. [/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]I want to thank all of you who made this mod possible with your downloads! :)[/font]
